data.desc: Five Below is a high-growth specialty retailer offering trend-right products at extreme value, for the kid and the kid in all of us. With most items priced between $1 and $5, Five Below delivers the newest, coolest stuff across seven worlds: Party, Play, Room, Snacks, Style, Tech and New & Now. Founded in 2002 and headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, the company now operates more than 2,000 stores in 47 states, with more on the way.
